subject: Odyssey vendor setup + aligning invoice cadence / early-pay options
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Lopez <s.lopez@odyssey-cloud.com>, Accounts Payable <ap@odyssey-cloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Odyssey vendor setup + aligning invoice cadence / early-pay options

Hi Sandra — great to meet last week. We're kicking off vendor setup so finance can activate POs and get the first invoice paid on our end. A couple of items we want to align on up front: 

1) Invoice cadence: what billing frequency do you expect (monthly, milestone, or per-delivery)? Our standard payment cycles are Net 30 and Net 45, with Net 60 available for some partner categories.

2) Early-pay / discount options: do you offer any discount for early settlement (e.g., 1-2% for Net 15 or accelerated ACH)? If so, please share the standard terms and an example calculation.

3) Onboarding docs: please complete the attached Vendor Onboarding Form and W9. Once submitted we will generate a Redwood PO from the attached PO template.

Attached: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (fillable), W9_Odyssey.pdf

If it's helpful, Marissa (Finance) and Lauren (Procurement) are copied to confirm the PO workflow and required fields. Would you be able to return the completed forms by EOD Tuesday so we can cut the PO on Wednesday?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183
[Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf, 220 KB)]
[Attachment: W9_Odyssey.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)]

From: Sandra Lopez <s.lopez@odyssey-cloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Accounts Payable <ap@odyssey-cloud.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 10:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Odyssey vendor setup + aligning invoice cadence / early-pay options

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear note. Quick answers below and I attached the filled onboarding form and W9 for your records.

1) Invoice cadence: Our default cadence is monthly on receipt of invoice. We can do milestone invoices for integration professional services if you prefer to stage payments.

2) Early-pay / discount: We offer an accelerated payment discount program via our treasury partner — standard options are 1% off if paid within 10 days (Net 10), or 0.5% off if paid within 15 days. For Net 30/45/60 we do not typically provide a discount unless arranged as part of a contract-level settlement.

3) PO process: We require a Redwood PO number on the invoice (we will match PO# to the invoice). Can you confirm whether Redwood sends PO acknowledgements (email) or if you use an automated EDI/portal?

Attached: Odyssey_Vendor_Onboarding_Completed.pdf, W9_Odyssey.pdf

I am looping in ap@odyssey-cloud.com to confirm bank details and remit instructions — they will send a secure portal link for the banking info.

Best,
Sandra Lopez
Head of Strategic Ops, Odyssey Cloud
[signed] 
[Attachment: Odyssey_Vendor_Onboarding_Completed.pdf (pdf, 230 KB)]
[Attachment: W9_Odyssey.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Lopez <s.lopez@odyssey-cloud.com>, Accounts Payable <ap@odyssey-cloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Odyssey vendor setup + aligning invoice cadence / early-pay options

Thanks Sandra — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple follow-ups from procurement/finance side: 

- Marissa: we’ll need bank details for ACH setup. Sandra mentioned a secure portal — can AP share the link and estimated time to complete?
- Lauren: please review Odyssey's completed onboarding form and confirm all required PO fields are present. I attached the Redwood PO template; we typically require PO#, line-level descriptions, expected ship/delivery date, and the billing contact.

On the early-pay: Odyssey's 1% Net 10 is attractive. From Redwood's perspective, we evaluate accelerated-pay discounts against liquidity and unit economics. If Odyssey can provide an automated electronic settlement discount program (example pricing and a sample invoice with discount calculated), we can route for commercial approval.

I also wanted to flag that for initial onboarding we plan to issue a short-term PO (30 days) for the first month's services to validate deliveries; subsequent POs would follow the agreed cadence.

Jordan

[Attachment: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (xlsx, 48 KB)]

From: Accounts Payable <ap@odyssey-cloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sandra Lopez <s.lopez@odyssey-cloud.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Odyssey vendor setup + aligning invoice cadence / early-pay options

Hi Marissa / Jordan — thanks for looping us in. We created a secure vendor portal link for Redwood to upload bank details and the signed onboarding packet: https://secure.odyssey-payments.com/portal/verify/tx-9f7b

Estimated time to verify bank details: 1-2 business days after upload. Once verified, we'll confirm ACH remit details and provide the vendor remit ID to include on invoices.

Regarding early-pay: we offer the discount program via our treasury partner and can provide sample settlement quotes once we have Redwood's preferred settlement window (Net 10 vs Net 15) and estimated monthly volume. To expedite pricing, please provide an estimate of monthly spend for the first quarter.

Regards,
AP Team
Accounts Payable, Odyssey Cloud
[Attachment: odyssey_treasury_PRICING.pdf (pdf, 90 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Accounts Payable <ap@odyssey-cloud.com>, Sandra Lopez <s.lopez@odyssey-cloud.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Odyssey vendor setup + aligning invoice cadence / early-pay options

Hi team — we uploaded the requested bank details and the signed onboarding form to the portal this morning (upload reference: UP-20270219-ODYSSEY). For the spend estimate: onboarding/professional services + first month of usage will be approximately $48,000 — recurring run-rate expected ~ $18k/month thereafter.

Jordan: from Finance's side, a quick decision framework we use for early-pay discounts: if the effective annualized discount cost (annualized from the offered short-term discount) exceeds our weighted cost of capital for the quarter, we decline; otherwise we approve. Please send any sample calculations or settlement windows Odyssey can provide and we’ll turn around a decision within 48 hours.

Lauren: once AP confirms vendor remit ID and PO# we can issue the initial 30-day PO.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PoUploadReceipt.txt (txt, 1 KB)]
